description: Device role doctrine — UMH is one organism with specialized organs

doctrine.principle: UMH is one organism with specialized organs. Device role assignment should be capability-aware: diagnose each node/device during onboarding, inspect capabilities, assign role based on constraints, route Work Packets to the right node.

on_node_join: diagnose CPU, GPU, memory, storage, uptime, network, trust, access, available runtimes
assign role based on capabilities and constraints
register node in organism runtime graph
route Work Packets based on node capability profile

constraints: 4 CPU cores shared with host + Docker
rules: UMH code may be developed here
Trinity app coding/building should NOT default here
orchestrates Trinity app work but does not execute heavy builds
default execution node for Trinity app coding/build tasks
receives Work Packets from VPS orchestrator
reports results back to VPS for truth recording

key_distinction: Code for Trinity apps does not live on the VPS. The VPS orchestrates that work: creates Work Packets, routes to Windows Beast, monitors execution, receives artifacts, verifies, records, reconciles, and promotes truth.
